data.title: First reminder: Muster Magazin subscription
data.summary: Muster Verlag GmbH sent a first reminder (1. Mahnung) for the unpaid annual fee of the "Muster Magazin" subscription. The total due is €61.90, including a €2.50 reminder fee, payable by 30 June 2025.
data.explanation: The publisher says your annual subscription fee for 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2026 is still unpaid. It asks you to transfer €61.90 (€59.40 plus a €2.50 reminder fee) by 30 June 2025. If you already paid, you can ignore the letter. If not, transfer the money to the account shown. If you don't recognise the subscription, contact the publisher's customer service before paying. Unpaid claims can lead to further reminders or collection steps.
